name: twitter/user-mentions
description: Recent tweets that mention a user by username, with optional time range and cursor pagination.

cursor.description: The cursor to paginate through the results. First page is empty.

userName.description: The user screen name to get mentions for.

sinceTime.description: On or after a specified unix timestamp in seconds. Provider reference (supplier schema): `{"format":"int64","type":"integer"}`.

untilTime.description: Before a specified unix timestamp in seconds. Provider reference (supplier schema): `{"format":"int64","type":"integer"}`.

pricing.note: Billed per call from metered usage; the reference price is typical.
